description: U 型门把手（sweep 扫掠）
description_en: A U-shaped door handle using sweep
code:
import cadquery as cq
import math

# === 参数 ===
grip_length = 120  # 握柄长度 (mm)
grip_d = 16        # 握柄直径 (mm)
offset = 50        # 离墙距离 (mm)
bend_r = 20        # 弯曲半径 (mm)
mount_d = 12       # 安装柱直径 (mm)
mount_h = 10       # 安装柱高度 (mm)

# === 握柄路径: 竖直-弯曲-水平-弯曲-竖直 ===
path = (
    cq.Workplane("XZ")
    .moveTo(0, 0)
    .lineTo(0, offset - bend_r)
    .radiusArc((bend_r, offset), -bend_r)
    .lineTo(grip_length - bend_r, offset)
    .radiusArc((grip_length, offset - bend_r), -bend_r)
    .lineTo(grip_length, 0)
)

# === 握柄 ===
result = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .circle(grip_d / 2)
    .sweep(path)
)

# === 安装座 ===
mount1 = cq.Workplane("XY").circle(mount_d / 2).extrude(-mount_h)
mount2 = cq.Workplane("XY").center(grip_length, 0).circle(mount_d / 2).extrude(-mount_h)

result = result.union(mount1).union(mount2)

show_object(result)
